title: Distribution-Matching Posterior Inference for Incomplete Structural Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.01077v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distribution-matching posterior inference (DMPI) extends the minimal econometric interpretation to generalized posterior inference and model comparison for incomplete structural models. It combines a structural-parameter prior with exact Dirichlet-multinomial scores comparing empirical and model-implied distributions of selected population moments. Ensemble size controls structural discipline, and annealed sequential Monte Carlo computes posterior and generalized evidence. In New Keynesian Phillips Curve simulations, a stochastically singular model remains useful under moderate discipline despite failing as an exact representation. In a U.S. three-equation New Keynesian DSGE application, restoring full rank raises or lowers generalized evidence depending on the structural innovation added.

translated_title: 不完全结构模型的分布匹配后验推断
translated_abstract: 分布匹配后验推断（DMPI）将最小计量经济学解释扩展至不完全结构模型的广义后验推断与模型比较。该方法将结构参数先验与精确的狄利克雷-多项式评分相结合，用以比较选定总体矩的经验分布与模型隐含分布。集成规模控制结构约束的强度，退火序贯蒙特卡洛方法用于计算后验分布和广义证据。在新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线模拟中，一个随机奇异模型在适度约束下仍然有用，尽管它作为精确的模型表示会失效。在美国三方程新凯恩斯DSGE模型的应用中，恢复满秩会根据所添加的结构性新息的不同，使广义证据提高或降低。
tldr: 该论文提出分布匹配后验推断（DMPI）方法，将结构参数先验与狄利克雷-多项式评分相结合，为不完全结构模型提供了广义后验推断和模型比较的新框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Distribution-Matching Posterior Inference (DMPI), a novel framework that combines structural-parameter priors with exact Dirichlet-multinomial scores to enable generalized posterior inference and model comparison for incomplete structural models.
